scam_info.notes: Published 11 Dec 2025 (body JS-rendered). Consumer spam-vs-scam guidance; /individuals/resources-tips?topic=Spam+vs+Scam lists the topic. The sitemap (829 URLs, lastmod) has 69 keyword URLs, mostly "advisory guidelines" (regulatory, not scams). Scam-relevant: the two PDPC-impersonation advisories, the robocall advisory, and the Do Not Call (DNC) registry pages (/about/do-not-call-registry, /media-events/dnc-registry-figures).

notes: Part of IMDA. Runs the DNC registry; organisation number checks require login. Impersonated in GOIS (fake PDPC officers, 2025). Advisory bodies are JS-rendered, so only metadata is available without probing backend APIs. No RSS seen.
